scientific_integrity: An analytical proof of the exact determinant and unique global design is included. Finite numerical checks corroborate but do not certify the universal proof. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed nonunit relative modulus, four consecutive times, equal observation weights, known two-mode evolution, unrestricted four-coordinate Hermitian lifting and determinant D-criterion only.
Does not optimize nonlinear rank-one recovery, heteroscedastic intensities, unknown spectral parameters, nonconsecutive samples, or larger spaces.
General Vandermonde injectivity is known prior work; historical priority of the explicit angular design is provisional.
title: D-optimal angular separation for four phaseless samples of a damped two-mode flow
